Solo mode In Solo mode, does the Movement deck not  reshuffle? Players just have 9/8/7 turns to  win? Answer:  Yes, they should be able to win during  this time.  4.   Legendary Hunt rules, p. 7 (Solo  Mode) If the Legendary Monster is unable to perform  the Movement, the Player draws 1 Legendary  Monster Movement card and places it to the  game box. They do not place the Destruction  token on the Game Board. Does that mean “discard the current LH move - ment card”, “discard one more LH movement  card in addition to the current card,” or some - thing else entirely? Answer:  The current card. There may be a mo - ment in the game, it will be obvious that the  Legendary Monster is not able to perform any  movement (it has the destruction tokens all  around). If so, you draw a card anyway and  place it in the game box (so you do not have  an “extra round”). 5.   Legendary Hunt rules, p. 7 (Solo  Mode) If the Player drives the Legendary Monster  away, they do not draw a Legendary Monster  Movement card. Instead, they choose any con - nected Location. One without a Destruction token, presumably?  Or are you allowed drive away the Legendary  Monster to a location with a Destruction token  in LH Solo Mode? Answer:  Yes, one without a Destruction token.  It’s impossible to drive the LM away if there is  no “free” connected location. 

11 6.   Gain new card from Destruction  token  From rules, p. 6, Destruction token bonuses:  Does that 0-cost card go to your discard pile?  Answer:  Yes, it does. 7.   Defeated by legendary monster  From rules, p. 7: Fight Outcome If the Player kills the Legendary Monster, they  win the game. If the Player fails to kill the Legendary Monster,  the Player is defeated and draws 1 Destruction  token from the pool, gains its immediate bo - nus, and places it face down near their Player  Board. Does that defeat outcome replace the defeat  outcome from the base game (Take 1 Trail To - ken, Add a 0-cost Action Card, and draw 1 card  less during Phase III)? You just take a Destruc - tion token, gain its bonus, reshuffle your deck  and proceed to Phase III? Answer:  Yes, exactly like that. 8.   LM unable to move  The solo rules explain that if the LM is unable  to move, the Player should draw a card (and  discard it) anyway. But this comes as one of  the differences in the solo mode. So how is  this dealt with in a game with 2+ Players? If  at the start of the LM’s Turn, all Connected  Locations have Destruction Tokens, the Last  Player doesn’t draw a Movement card, then?  There was a sentence, “all consecutive move - ments this Turn are ignored,” but I guess it  only applied to the LM unable to move during  the 2nd or further movement. In the example  I mentioned here, the LM cannot move since  the beginning of its turn. Answer:  In that case, this movement is ignored  as well. 

12 9.   Frightener’s Special Ability 3 different types based on the card title or the  card color?  Answer:  Color. 10.   Special Fight Cards This is not like other monster cards written  in detail. Which of the following is the effect of this  card? Empty deck:  1. any cards from their hand.   2. chosen cards from their hand. 3. random card from their hand. Answer:  Any cards from their hand. 11.   Destruction tokens What if there is no more destruction tokens  in the pool? Answer:  The Legendary Monster movement  is performed. However, it does not leave any  destruciton tokens on its way. 12.   4th+ trophies  A.  In Legendary Hunt, players don’t win when  they gain 4th trophy in battle? Answer:  No, they do not. B.  If not, when a player gains the 4th+ trophy  and moves to the top of the Trophy track (help  card has last spot next to the last spot on Tro - phy track) then how many cards do they trash  when moving there? And how much gold do  players get from defeating that witcher? Answer:  You do not trash any card and gain  0 gold. 

13 1.   Multiple Dagon Bonus cards Can a player have multiple Dagon Bonus  cards? If yes, does the second effect of these  cards add up (so Dagon moves multiple steps  after any of the Player’s fights)? Answer:  Yes, you can have more than one  Dagon Bonus card, and their effects add up. 2.   Dagon Bonus card 5  I am right that the effect of this card triggers  only when all of the following are true: •   Your last movement was from Island or  Dagon to the Continent location. •   This turn that effect hasn’t been triggered  yet in a location where you are. •   Now you are moving to another Continent  location OR ending Phase I. (that seems a bit complicated condition). Answer:  The last movement must not be  performed from the Island/Dagon Location.  What’s necessary is: there is a ship in the  entered location, and you are not using it.  3.   Dagon Bonus card 5 again It works when you travel from Island to Conti - nent (and don’t travel to Island again)? It’s con - sidered “enter a Continent Location with a Ship”  despite that Ship it is a Ship on which you just  traveled back from Island? Answer:  No, it does not work in that case. 4.   Dagon’s Special Ability By its effect, players discard 1 random card per  Trophy they have? (or this part applies only to  Shield level lowering and always exactly 1 card  discards?). Answer:  1 card is constant. Lowering Shield  level depends on the number of Trophy cards. 

14 5.   Dagon Bonus card 2 Water location where you move by that ability  must be Connected to your present location  or not? Answer:  No, that may be any Water Location. 6.   Ulf’heid Effect  The Player randomly draws a Level-1,  2 or 3 Monster token from the pool. Can I choose between each level stack? Or  from whole-level tokens? For example, may I choose only Level  1 tokens? Or should my pool be a whole level? Answer:  You choose the level. 7.    Dagon reward Any chosen 0-cost card from the pool of the  6 available. I assume that 0-cost card goes to your hand.  Am I right? Answer:  To your discard pile. You draw a card  to your hand only during phase III. 8.   Exploration card 14 choice What do you do if you cannot pay for any  choice? Maybe the first choice should be add - ed “Empty hand: do not discard any card.” like  in card 6? Answer:  You pay as much as you can. 9.   Dagon Bonus 2nd effect optionality The choice to activate any effect from cards in  the game is up to the player. But what about  the second effect from the Dagon Bonus card?  Is it required? Or the player can activate or not  activate it at will, after the Fight? Answer:  It is required.  10.   Island and Dagon Location travel in  1 turn Can a player travel in one turn to an Island lo - cation, back to the continent, and then to the  Dagon location to fight him? Answer:  Yes, they can. 11.   Are Dagon Bonus cards trophies? Dagon cards considered are Trophies (for ef - fects such a “per each Trophy card”)? Answer:  No, they are not. 

15 12.   Dagon Bonus card second ability  trigger  When does the second effect of Dagon Bonus  cards exactly trigger? After resolving a Fight  outcome or before?  If after: It triggers immediately after you get  this card (so the Dagon miniature is placed  on its appropriate spot and immediately  moves up)? In any case: It triggers when you win Dagon  and already have this card? Answer:  It does not trigger immediately af - ter receiving this card. But if you fight Dagon  for the second time, having this card already,  Dagon moves up by one immediately after  this fight. 

16 1.   Event card 67 Is the Map ability used during the Movement  step instead of a regular movement or does  it allow an additional movement during the  player’s turn? Answer:  You have to play a card to do it so it’s  treated as a regular movement during the  player’s turn. 2.   Event card 11  that effect allows you to move to these loca - tions from connected locations, just with any  card? Or does it allow you to move there from  any location (“teleport” from even another  side of the map)? Answer:  The first one. 3.   Event card 89 What Level? Alchemy? Answer:  Character’s level. 4.    Location tokens for Quest tokens How this effect (AP Exploration card 38) and  similar should work in regards to drawn loca - tion token: •   It is placed onto that Exploration card and  remains there until associated Quest token  is removed; •   Or it shuffles back into the pile immediately  after determining the Quest token location? Answer:  The first one. 

17 1.   Arachas Weakness II That ability can be used at any time (even at  the Monster’s turn) any number of times? Answer:  During Player’s Fight Turn, any num - ber of times (a number of Potions is the limit). 2.   Harpy Weakness VI You must alter the order of these cards and  can’t place them in the same order? Answer:  It may be the same order. 3.   Monster Weakness  Can Monster Weakness block the Monster  Ability? Answer:  Yes, it can. 4.   Monster Weakness token Should the Monster Weakness token initially  placed in location be any random MW token  or it should be a random MW token of the  same Terrain type as a location itself? Answer:  Same type as the Location itself. 5.   Pirouette Action card A.  Which color of extension you can use when  adding Pirouette to the combo? Yellow (purple/ green for other versions of card), blue, any of  them? Answer:  The Pirouette is a blue card and it has  to be preceded with a blue extension.  B.  To activate its special effect Pirouette should  be connected to a yellow (purple/green) card  right before it? Or yellow (purple/green) cards  should just be anywhere in your combo before  Pirouette? Answer:  Right before. 6.   Mutagens If the Mutagen cards deck runs out, play - ers just stop getting anything from further  level-ups? Or they may at least draw a card(s)  as per base rules? Answer:  They draw cards as per base rules. 7.   Bombs  By default, Bombs can be used like Potions:  only on your Fight turn at Step 1? Answer:  Sometimes their effect applies later  (i.e., Dragon’s Dream). 

18 8.   Critical Hit Action card  Because you can perform Special Effects of  your Combo in any order, this means that you  can choose first to activate that card effect  (now you should draw 0 cards) and then  other effects that allow you to draw more (now  you should draw some cards despite playing  Critical Strike)? Answer:  No, if this card is in your combo, other  modifiers do not apply. 9.   Dragon’s Dream bomb  deals damage immediately as you play a pur - ple card before you ended play your Combo?  Or does it add one damage to Combo when  it’s done?  Answer:  The first damage is dealt immediately.  The additional damage is added when the  combo is done. 10.   yghern Weakness II Does the card’s Fight Ability also include the  text or only the icons? Are the icon effects to  draw fewer cards doubled as well? Answer:  Only icons. Draw decreasing is  doubled as well. 11.   Griffin Weakness III That’s some ambiguous effect: >take 1 Special Monster Fight card... Can I choose which one? Answer:  Random card from the already pre - pared Monster’s Life Pool, .and replace it with  a regular Monster Fight card taken from the  non-used monster fight cards. 12.   Wild Hunt and Monster Special At - tacks combination When playing with “Monster Weakness  and Special Attacks” until Level 3 Monster  appears, the Monster Fight cards deck con - tains 16 cards. What should we do when play - ing with “Wild Hunt” and a monster has its  Life Pool increased over 16 when our Monster  Fight cards deck still contains only 16 cards? Answer:  Wild Hunt special effect cannot  extend the Monster’s Life Pool above 20 (in  that case, above 16). 

19 13.   Striga passive ability  – how does it work? Answer:  A.  Striga with combo: 1.   Player plays their combo of, let’s say  3 cards with 5 damage symbols. 2.   Monster controller discards the first card,  and second card. The second card is  a Monster special fight card.  3.   The first half of the passive ability is  triggered. Striga stops discarding cards.  4.   The second half of the passive ability is  triggered, since the Player already played  their combo, as you can see in 1). The  player returns the last card in their combo  to their hand. B.  Striga without combo 5.   Player used a bomb card and deal  1 damage to Striga in step 1 of their fight  turn. 6.   Monster controller discarded Monster  special fight card, triggers the first half of  passive ability. 7.   The second half of passive does not trig - ger since the player hasn’t played their  combo. 8.   Player plays their combo with 3 damage  symbols. Since the first half of passive  ability has been triggered, this combo  deals no damage. 9.   According to 3), player does not return the  combo’s last card to their had. 14.   Troll’s passive action  Can you use Troll’s passive action to draw  special fight card? Answer:  No, you cannot, that would make  Troll immortal. 15.   Fiend - Furios Charge Attack   Does Fiend perform its next Fight Turn in both  cases, or only when Player cannot discard  1 Fast Attack card? Answer:  Both. 16.   Yghern - venomous pincers Can this ability only discard 1 or 2 potions? 1. Yes: Decrease 1 Damage / 1 Potion              Decrease 3 Damage / 2 Potions 2. No:  Decrease 1 Damage / 1 Potion             Decrease 3 Damage / 2 Potions            Decrease 4 (1+3) Damage / 3 Potions            Decrease 6 (3+3) Damage / 4 Potions I think it’s option 1 (yes) myself, but I have to  be sure of the answer. Answer:  Option 1 (yes) is correct. 

20 17.   Viper Special Ability  Viper Special Ability, if I discard a Monster  Special Attack Card does it trigger the  passive?  Answer:  No, the passive effect is not  triggered. 18.   Dice on monster cards Some special attacks (Leshen, Rotfiend)  place dice on a monster card. These are dis - carded at the end of Fight if the monster was  not defeated and remains on board? Answer:  Yes, they are discarded. You “reset”  the monster after the fight. 19.   Manticore Venomous Sting  “... If they have no Potions…” — after they  discard 1 or before? Answer:  Before. 20.   Nightwraith Weakness IV These card draws occur “During Step 4 of  your first Fight Turn”? It’s really intended to  be “+3 cards for EACH yellow in your combo”?  (Looks overpowered) Answer:  Remember, that your hand limit  is 7. So yes, that allows you to draw up to  7 cards quite easily during step 4 of your first  fight turn. 

21 1.   Energy and Shield When resolving effects like “immediately play  a Combo (only apply Shields…)” for Mage do  you apply Energy symbols instead of Shields? Answer:  Yes. 2.   Philippa and Alzur Speciality What happens if the result should be  0 or lower? It stays at 1? At 0? Or you cannot  choose any effect? Answer:  You cannot choose. 3.   Signs When an effect states “If you have Yrden sign  card”, without mentioning the card color -  what happens if you play as a Mage? (Same  for other signs) Answer:  Mages never have Yrden or any other  sign in their hand or combo. 4.   Extensions  When does the effect from used extensions re - solve? Strictly after boost effect: Basic > Boost  > Extension? Answer:  Yes, it’s resolved after the basic effect  but before the extensions and the next card. 5.   Transformation Action card Should you use your Speciality the same turn  when playing this card to activate its effect?  Or you could use Speciality any earlier turn,  and it still counts for this card effect? Answer:  It could be used earlier in the Fight. 6.   Monster passive action  Can Monster passive action stop the Mage in  the middle of their combo? Answer:  No, you play the whole combo  together and sum up all the damage first (re - solving it card by card). It is said to resolve it  card by card due to the Energy mechanics -  you can gain some Energy with one card and  spend it to boost another card in the same  combo. 7.   Energy  Is energy always limited by 4 (maximum value  on player board)? Answer:  Yes, it is. 

22 1.   Koshchey Special Ability - what does it affect? About that part: “ignores all the Fight Abilities  from the Offensive Sign (purple) cards.” What exactly should be ignored from purple  cards? All but non-purple Extension effects? Special
actions: actions ignored too? Answer:  Special Action applies. Non-purple  extension effects apply. Anything else  is ignored. 2.   Koshchey Koshchey Large card back - the part “If there  is no Blizzard in the deck, draw any 1 Potion.”  - does it mean the player can choose any  1 card in the deck? Answer:  Yes.  3.   Siren When Siren is defeated or driven away new  monster spawns? Answer: No. 1.   Lost Mount When the player enters the location which  the Lost Mount is in and ends his phase  I, who will pick the 2 location tokens and  choose 1, the last player or the active player? Answer:  The last player. 1.   Mounted Eredin The ability “drawing only a location token”  - what does it mean? Answer:  That means you do not draw  a Monster Token randomly, because it’s  Eredin. You draw only the location token.
